skills.description: 面向 AI Agent Skill 的纯本地安全审计器：启动自动扫描、安装后静默体检，支持单 Skill 深度审计与跨平台批量扫描（WorkBuddy / Claude Code / Cursor / OpenClaw），输出准入判定、风险评分、能力画像、来源信誉与机器可读导出（SARIF/SBOM/JSON），内置规则包分离、策略引擎与信任注册表、更新投毒 Diff 告警、污点/数据流与混淆载荷检测、OSV 依赖查询与 CI 门禁。 Skill Analyzer is a pure-local static security auditor for AI agent Skills. It runs automatically at startup, silently scans newly installed Skills with antivirus-style logging, and supports single-Skill deep audit and cross-platform batch scanning (WorkBuddy/Claude Code/Cursor/OpenClaw). Outputs a verdict (BLOCK/NEED_REVIEW/REVIEW/PASS), 0-100 risk score, capability profile, source reputation and machine-readable exports (SARIF/SBOM/JSON). Features include rule-pack separation, policy engine & trust registry, update-poisoning diff alerts, taint/data-flow and obfuscation payload detection, OSV dependency lookup and CI exit codes.
